title: Clearer app authorization and key guidance
summary:
Clearer key permissions and guidance, a new route for DeepSeek V3.2, and another developer tool in the catalog.

The authorization page now lists requested text, image, audio, and video permissions alongside Pollen balance, key expiry, and model access. Key guidance across the docs, dashboard, website, and MCP responses now consistently describes the publishable-key limit as 1 Pollen per IP per hour and clarifies that both key types spend the account’s Pollen. The wording changed; rate-limit behavior did not.

DeepSeek V3.2 now routes through Fireworks AI instead of Google Vertex AI MaaS in the shared registry and text API. The `deepseek-v3` and `deepseek-reasoning` aliases remain. The team also removed explicit `max-tokens` overrides from the Fireworks configurations for GLM-4.7 and MiniMax M2.1.

An agent-added catalog entry brings @FabioArieiraBaia’s PolliDev, a tool for managing generative image assets and prompts, to Dev_Tools and the README showcase. The YouTube MASHINA showcase entry was removed.
